title: Can machines think?
text: In 1950, Alan Turing asked: can machines think? He turned that question toward an imitation game. Through written questions and replies, could an interrogator distinguish a machine from a person?
translation: 1950 年，图灵问：机器能思考吗？他用模仿游戏把问题具体化：通过文字问答，提问者能否分辨机器和人？

title: An ambition gets a name
text: Five years later, a proposal gave a research ambition a name: artificial intelligence. McCarthy, Minsky, Rochester and Shannon proposed a summer project at Dartmouth.
translation: 1955 年，麦卡锡、明斯基、罗切斯特和香农在达特茅斯夏季研究项目的提案中，使用了“人工智能”这个名称。

title: Dartmouth, summer 1956
text: In the summer of 1956, researchers met to explore how machines might use language, form concepts, solve problems and improve themselves. A shared research field was taking shape around those questions.
translation: 1956 年夏天，研究者相聚达特茅斯，讨论机器如何使用语言、形成概念、解决问题，以及改进自身。共同的研究领域逐渐形成。

title: Reason with rules
text: One approach made knowledge explicit. Represent objects and goals with symbols, then use rules to find a sequence of actions. In a small, orderly world, the machine could reason its way from a problem to a plan.
translation: 符号主义将物体、知识和目标明确表示出来，再利用规则寻找行动序列。在一个有限而有序的环境中，机器能够推导出解决问题的计划。

title: Learn from examples
text: Connectionist approaches took another route: adjust connections through experience. Rosenblatt's perceptron learned to separate patterns. An error changed its weights, moving the boundary for the next example. Learning could replace some rules written by hand.
translation: 连接主义尝试从经验中调整连接。罗森布拉特的感知机学习区分模式，错误推动权重更新，进而改变分类边界。一部分规则可以通过学习获得。

title: When the search grows too large
text: But larger problems multiplied the possibilities. Computing resources were limited, and early demonstrations did not deliver all that had been promised. In the nineteen seventies, funding and confidence fell in parts of the field.
translation: 问题变大后，可能的选择迅速增加。计算资源有限，早期演示难以兑现全部承诺。20 世纪 70 年代，部分方向的资助与信心回落，第一次寒冬到来。

title: Put expertise into rules
text: In the nineteen eighties, expert systems brought specialist knowledge into practical software. Facts activated rules and led to recommendations. But expanding and maintaining those rules could become expensive, especially when conditions changed.
translation: 20 世纪 80 年代，专家系统将专业知识写入软件。事实触发规则，得到判断与建议。随着条件改变，规则的扩充和维护成本也逐渐显现。

title: Intelligence in action
text: Behavior-based robotics emphasized a different question: how can a machine act in the world? Rodney Brooks built layered controllers that connected sensing to action. Avoid an obstacle, keep moving, and respond again as the situation changes.
translation: 行为主义机器人研究关注机器如何在真实环境中行动。布鲁克斯的分层控制器将感知和行动连接起来：避开障碍、继续移动，并随环境变化再次响应。

title: Errors teach the hidden layers
text: A network could learn more than a final decision. Backpropagation carried the output error through its layers, showing how each parameter contributed. By adjusting those parameters, hidden layers could learn useful representations. Work in the nineteen eighties helped bring this approach to prominence.
translation: 网络能够学习的不只是最终判断。反向传播将输出误差传过各层，计算各个参数对误差的影响。调整参数后，隐藏层能够学习有用的表示。20 世纪 80 年代的工作推动了这一方法的广泛应用。

title: Another winter. Research continues.
text: Commercial enthusiasm cooled again in the late nineteen eighties and early nineties. Expert systems faced costs and limits. Yet neural networks, statistical learning and robotics continued developing, even as the spotlight moved away.
translation: 20 世纪 80 年代末至 90 年代初，商业热情再次降温。专家系统暴露出成本和能力局限；神经网络、统计学习与机器人等方向仍在推进。

title: Learning to see
text: For images, convolutional networks learn patterns that repeat across space. A small filter moves across the pixels, producing a feature map. Layers combine local features into richer representations. Networks such as LeNet used this approach to recognize handwritten digits.
translation: 对于图像，卷积网络学习可以在不同位置出现的模式。小卷积核扫过像素，产生特征图；层层组合形成更丰富的表示。LeNet 等网络用这种方式识别手写数字。

title: A state carried through time
text: Language unfolds in a sequence. A recurrent network reads one step at a time, combining the new input with a state carried from the past. The same computation repeats, but its state changes as the sentence grows.
translation: 语言按序列展开。循环网络逐步读取输入，将新输入与之前传来的状态结合。同一套计算不断重复，状态随着句子推进而变化。

title: Choosing what to remember
text: Long sequences made learning distant dependencies difficult. LSTM introduced a memory cell with gates. Later, a forget gate gave it a way to control what to retain. Information can be preserved, updated, and selectively exposed as the sequence continues.
translation: 长序列中，远距离依赖难以学习。LSTM 引入带有门控的记忆单元；后来的遗忘门进一步控制保留的信息。序列推进时，记忆可以被保留、更新，并选择性地输出。

title: Data, compute, deep networks
text: Meanwhile, computer graphics was building a different kind of engine: processors that handled many calculations in parallel. CUDA, introduced in 2006 with its first full toolkit release in 2007, made that power easier to program for other tasks. Neural network training had a powerful new platform. The pieces came together: a large labeled dataset, fast GPU computation, and a deep convolutional network. In 2012, AlexNet won the ImageNet competition by a striking margin, training on two GPUs. The result drew widespread attention to what deep learning could do when data, architecture, and computation worked together.
translation: 图形处理器擅长并行计算。CUDA 在 2006 年提出架构、2007 年发布首个正式工具包，使这种算力更容易用于神经网络。2012 年，数据、GPU 和深层卷积网络汇合：使用两块 GPU 训练的 AlexNet 赢得 ImageNet 竞赛，展示了深度学习的潜力。

title: Look back at the relevant words
text: Attention changed how a translation model used its input. Instead of relying on one fixed summary, the decoder could combine source representations differently at each step. As each output word formed, attention shifted toward the input positions that helped predict it.
translation: 注意力改变了翻译模型使用输入的方式。解码器可以在每一步以不同权重组合源句的表示。输出词逐步生成，注意力也转向有助于预测的输入位置。

title: Learning to create
text: In 2014, generative adversarial networks paired two learners. A generator creates samples from noise. A discriminator compares generated samples with real data. Its feedback helps train the generator. Across training, the competition can produce increasingly convincing images.
translation: 2014 年，生成对抗网络让两个模型共同学习。生成器从噪声产生样本，判别器区分生成样本和真实数据，并为生成器提供训练信号。随着训练推进，生成的图像可以越来越逼真。

title: Learning from pixels and rewards
text: DQN learned to play Atari games from pixels. A neural network estimated the value of available actions. Acting, receiving rewards, and replaying experience gradually improved its decisions.
translation: DQN 从像素中学习玩 Atari 游戏。神经网络估计各个动作的价值；执行动作、获得奖励，再回放过去的经验，让它逐渐学会做出更好的决策。

title: Learning to choose
text: In 2016, AlphaGo brought learning and search together. A policy network suggested promising moves; a value network assessed positions. Guided search explored possible continuations. Training on expert games and through self-play turned experience into better decisions, one position at a time.
translation: 2016 年，AlphaGo 将学习与搜索结合起来：策略网络提出有希望的落点，价值网络评估局面，搜索继续推演可能的走法。学习人类棋谱、通过自我对弈训练，让积累的经验转化成更好的判断。

title: Attention becomes the architecture
text: In 2017, the Transformer placed attention at the center. Multiple heads mixed information across positions, alongside feed-forward layers and residual connections. Positional information preserved order. Removing recurrence allowed positions to be processed in parallel during training. The original model joined an encoder to a decoder.
translation: 2017 年，Transformer 以注意力为核心。多头注意力在位置之间交换信息，配合前馈层、残差连接和位置信息。移除循环结构使训练时的位置计算能够并行。最初的模型连接编码器和解码器。

title: One architecture, different objectives
text: In 2018, BERT and GPT developed different branches. BERT used encoder layers and surrounding context to predict masked tokens. GPT used decoder-style layers to predict the next token from the preceding context. Their training objectives shaped how they learned from text.
translation: 2018 年，BERT 与 GPT 发展出不同分支。BERT 使用编码器层，利用双向上下文预测被遮盖的 token；GPT 使用解码器式层，从前面的上下文预测下一个 token。训练目标塑造了它们学习文本的方式。

title: A prediction becomes a learning signal
text: Pretraining repeats this process across large collections of text. The model makes a prediction, compares it with the training target, and updates its parameters to reduce the loss. The resulting representations can then support many tasks, often with further training or adaptation.
translation: 预训练在大量文本上重复进行：模型作出预测，与训练目标比较，通过更新参数减小损失。得到的表示能够用于多种任务，通常再配合后续训练或适配。

title: One token becomes the next context
text: During generation, the model turns the current context into a distribution over possible next tokens. A token is selected and appended to the input. Then the model runs again. Its parameters stay fixed while the context grows, one token after another.
translation: 生成时，模型把当前上下文转成下一个 token 的概率分布。选出的 token 接回输入，模型再次运行。参数保持不变，上下文随着 token 逐步增长。

title: Examples become part of the prompt
text: Larger language models changed what a prompt could do. In 2020, GPT-3 demonstrated tasks specified through instructions and a few examples. A pattern shown in the context could guide the next response. The same pretrained model could be prompted to attempt different tasks.
translation: 更大规模的语言模型改变了提示词能够做的事情。2020 年，GPT-3 展示了通过指令和少量示例指定任务的能力。上下文里的模式能够引导下一次回答，同一个预训练模型可以通过提示尝试不同任务。

title: Generation through denoising
text: Diffusion takes another route. A network learns to remove noise from corrupted examples. To generate, it starts with random noise and refines a sample over many steps. Broad structure emerges, details settle, and a new image takes shape.
translation: 扩散模型走了另一条路：网络从被加噪的样本中学习去噪。生成时，从随机噪声开始，经过多次迭代逐渐形成图像。先显出大体结构，再逐步补出细节。

title: Images become tokens
text: Vision Transformers split images into patches. Each patch becomes an embedding, with position information. Attention connects the sequence, building representations for image recognition and beyond.
translation: 视觉 Transformer 把图像切成小块，将每块映射为带有位置信息的表示。注意力连接这些图像块，构建可用于图像识别等任务的表示。

title: Images and words meet
text: In 2021, CLIP learned from images paired with text. Separate encoders map both into a shared representation. Training pulls matching pairs together and separates mismatches. A phrase can then retrieve an image, linking visual recognition with the flexibility of language.
translation: 2021 年，CLIP 从图像和文字配对数据中学习。两个编码器把它们映射到同一个表示空间。训练让相配的图文靠近、不相配的分开，于是可以用一句文字去检索图像。

title: AI becomes a scientific instrument
text: AI also began changing the tools of science. AlphaFold 2 used evolutionary relationships and learned interactions between amino acids to predict protein structures. Its architecture exchanged information across sequences and residue pairs, then refined three-dimensional geometry, opening new possibilities for studying biology.
translation: AI 也开始改变科学研究的工具。AlphaFold 2 利用进化关系和学习到的氨基酸相互作用预测蛋白质结构。架构在序列与残基对之间交换信息，再细化三维几何，为理解生命系统提供了新的可能。

title: Language models become assistants
text: To make a model follow instructions, researchers trained on demonstrations of useful answers. Human comparisons then helped train a reward model, guiding further optimization. InstructGPT brought these steps together. Later in 2022, ChatGPT put conversation at the center of how millions encountered this technology.
translation: 为了让模型遵循指令，研究者先用有用回答的示范进行训练，再根据人类对回答的比较训练奖励模型，指导后续优化。InstructGPT 串起了这些步骤。2022 年末，ChatGPT 让对话成为许多人接触这项技术的入口。

title: Reason, act, observe
text: A language model can also act. ReAct interleaves reasoning with tool use and observations. Here, the model searches for a paper, reads the result, then opens the source to verify its venue. Each observation informs the next action before the final answer.
translation: 语言模型也可以采取行动。ReAct 将推理、工具调用和观察交替进行。这里，模型先搜索论文，阅读结果，再打开原文核对发表场所。每次观察都为下一步行动提供依据，最后给出答案。

title: Learning inside imagined futures
text: A world model learns how an environment changes. From observations, it predicts possible future states and rewards. An agent can improve its policy inside these imagined trajectories, then act in the real environment and learn again from what actually happens. Imagination becomes useful experience.
translation: 世界模型学习环境怎样变化：从观察出发，预测未来状态和回报。智能体可以在这些想象出的轨迹中改进策略，再回到真实环境执行动作，根据实际发生的事情继续学习。想象也能成为有用的经验。

title: Worlds you can act in
text: Genie learned controllable environments from video. Starting from an image, actions steer the next generated frames. Walk, or jump: the same scene unfolds into different futures.
translation: Genie 从视频中学习可控制的环境。从一张图像出发，动作会影响接下来生成的画面。向前走，或是跳起来，同一个场景就会展开不同的未来。

title: Vision, language, action
text: Robots connect language to the physical world. A vision-language-action model receives camera images and an instruction, then predicts robot actions. The arm reaches, closes its gripper, and places the object. New observations close the loop, grounding the next action in a changing scene.
translation: 机器人把语言与物理世界连接起来。视觉—语言—动作模型接收相机图像和指令，预测机器人的动作。机械臂靠近物体、合拢夹爪，再将它放到目标位置。新的观察反馈回来，让下一步动作建立在变化后的场景上。

title: Feedback shapes a reasoning policy
text: Reinforcement learning also became a way to improve language model reasoning. On problems with checkable answers, rewards could guide training toward more successful solutions. DeepSeek-R1 explored this at scale in 2025. Trying, evaluating, and improving now shaped how a language model approached difficult problems.
translation: 强化学习也成为改善语言模型推理的方法。在答案可以检验的问题上，奖励能够引导训练找到更有效的解法。2025 年，DeepSeek-R1 对这条路线进行了大规模探索。尝试、评估、改进，也塑造了语言模型解决难题的方式。

title: The research paths meet
text: These paths keep crossing. Attention connects information. Generative models construct possible outputs. Reinforcement learning improves decisions through feedback. Together, these ideas support assistants, robots, world models, and scientific tools. Each new system carries pieces of a much longer history.
translation: 这些路线持续交汇：注意力连接信息，生成模型构造可能的输出，强化学习通过反馈改善决策。这些思想共同支持助手、机器人、世界模型和科学工具。每个新系统都带着这段漫长历史的一部分。

title: Towards general intelligence
text: The pursuit of general intelligence asks how these abilities might extend to unfamiliar problems, new environments, and continued learning. The next chapter will be shaped by the questions people ask, and the things they choose to build. You can be part of it. The future is in your hands.
translation: 对通用智能的探索，追问这些能力怎样延伸到陌生问题、新环境和持续学习之中。人们提出的问题和选择创造的事物，将塑造下一个篇章。你也可以成为其中的一部分。未来，在你手中。
